senses.gloss:
लप् लप्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Nal. 21, 16).
 1. To speak, Gīt. 1, 41.
 2. To lament, Nal. 3, 27.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लपिता, n. Voice. Frequent. लालप्, लालप्य, To lament, MBh. 3, 10200. लालप्य, Par., MBh. 1, 968.
 --With the prep. अप अप, To deny, [] Rām. 2, 75, 24.
 --With आ आ, To address, MBh. 3, 15604.
 --Caus. लापय, To ask, Pañc. i. d. 431; 242, 13.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To prattle, Śāk. 13, 14.
 2. To speak, Pañc. 94, 12; to cry, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 309.
 3. To bewail, Pañc. 75, 25; MBh. 3, 1203.
 4. To invoke, MBh. 2, 2339. प्रलपित, n.
 1. Prattle, Pañc. 146, 1 (वृथा-, Useless words).
 2. Lamentation, Pañc. 224, 16.
 --Caus. To incite to speak, Mṛcch. 86, 14.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To wail, Hit. 44, 6, M.M.; MBh. 3, 1203.
 2. To bewail, Rām. 1, 1, 52.
 3. To speak, Johns. Sel. 51, 110.
 --With सम् सम्, To converse, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 7.
 --Caus. To cause to converse, to address, Hit. i. d. 77, M.M.
 --Cf. Lat. loqui; probably ὀλοϕύρομαι (a denomin. based on an old frequent. ὀλοπ and aff. वन्, with ρ for ν).

लपन लप् + अन, n.
 1. Speaking.
 2. The mouth.
